description: Zarea Limited is a Pakistani business-to-business commodities marketplace, listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, that digitalises procurement and distribution of commodities — building materials, chemicals, coal, steel, cement, grains and pulses, sugar, solar and agricultural inputs among them. Buyers and suppliers transact through its platform and mobile app, with related credit, logistics and daily-price services. Its head office is in Lahore, with a second site in Haripur and a regional office in Dubai.
